name: Learning to forgive
promise: Six days to release bitterness, guard the altar of your heart from offence and walk in the freedom of Christ's love.
why: Unresolved hurt and offence quietly poison the heart, blocking fellowship with God and derailing the destiny He has prepared. Across six days, Apostle Arome Osayi teaches how to spot bitterness early, shut the door of your heart against wounds, release those who wronged you and cultivate a secret life with God where offence loses its hold.

days.key_quote: As long as I wanted to respond in the flesh, bitterness found a foothold on my heart, and that foothold of bitterness was an obstruction to my ascendancy.

days.theme: Shutting the door of the heart to hurt
days.key_quote: Shut the door to bitterness. Shut the door to anger. Shut the door to pride. Shut the door to pain. Shut. You can shut the door.

days.theme: Keeping offence off the altar of prayer
days.key_quote: When someone comes close to you and insults you, you will do everything possible to make sure it doesn't affect your heart, because your shrine is there.

days.key_title: Release that person from your heart
days.key_quote: If you are going to maintain your personal altar, you cannot do it with malice. You cannot do it with bitterness. You cannot do it with wickedness. So release that person. Release that person from your heart.

days.theme: Refusing offence on the road to destiny
days.key_quote: You begin to do what you are doing because that is what you should be doing and because you love God sincerely, not because of any recognition.

days.theme: Becoming unoffendable in the secret place
days.key_quote: I want to introduce you to the God that is in the secret. And if you are going to see him, you shut the door. You shut that quarrel out. Shut those people out. If you are used to it, a time will come where people cannot make you angry again.
